claims.statement: WeChat Pay async notifications arrive at POST /wechatAuth/wxpay/notify (WxpayNotifyController under the /wechatAuth/wxpay mapping); WxpayNotifyFacade verifies the MD5 signature with the company's API key, then routes by the attach payload — attach=depositRecharge goes to the deposit-side port (rechargeCallback), everything else to the order-side port (applyTradePaymentAfterAlipay).

WxpayNotifyFacade is idempotent-replay safe: it catches BadRequestException/ResourceException (including the already-processed 更新已处理 exception thrown by the order-side NOTPAY guard) from the port call, logs at debug, and still returns XML SUCCESS; only unexpected failures (signature failure, missing config) produce the FAIL body.

WxpayNotifyPaymentContextLoader resolves the paying company before verification can occur: it tries WxpayNotifyCompanyIdPort.resolveCompanyIdByAuthorizerAppId (a wechat-authorization peek implemented in orders), then falls back to Redis appId-to-companyId maps (wechatPayment:companyId:, wechatAppPayment: for trade_type=APP, wechatServicerPayment:); the distributor-level setting key is resolved through AlipayNotifyOrderSidePort.resolveDistributorIdForAlipayRedis, which gates on distribution_distributor_peek.payment_subject=1 and returns 0 otherwise, so the setting key becomes (distributorId?) + wxPaymentSetting: + sha1(companyId).

All channel payment callbacks are JWT-exempt open endpoints: OperatorJwtAuthenticationFilter (espier) explicitly exempts POST /api/v1/alipay/notify, /api/v1/chinaums/notify, /api/v1/doumen-intl/notify, /api/v1/adapay/callback, the /api/v1/bspay/callback/ prefix, and the whole /wechatAuth/ legacy prefix — the wechat notify path space kept from PHP.

Each channel verifies notify authenticity with its own scheme before any state write: wxpay MD5 over sorted params plus API key; alipay RSA via the SDK; chinaums SHA-256 over sorted params concatenated with the ecshopx.ums.notify-md5-key; doumen-intl md5(rawBody + X-SecretKey) compared case-insensitively against the X-Signature header; bspay RSA-SHA256 (BsPayCallbackSignatureVerifier); adapay AdapaySignatureVerifier over the sign/data envelope.

The chinaums and doumen-intl notify facades ack broadly: ChinaumsNotifyFacade maps TRADE_SUCCESS to SUCCESS, acks TRADE_REFUND without processing (refunds arrive via the refund executor), and returns plain-text SUCCESS/FAILED; DoumenIntlNotifyFacade resolves the trade via findTrade before signature verification (the secret lives in the company's doumen setting), acks 00000000 for PENDING/RETRY_PENDING and unknown statuses, swallows ResourceException on apply (applyQuietly), and short-circuits when the trade is already SUCCESS/PAYERROR.

BsPayCallbackOrchestratorService whitelists callback event types: pay.wx_lite/pay.wx_pub/pay.wx_qr/pay.alipay_wap/pay.alipay_qr route as PAYMENT to BsPayOrdersTradePaymentCallbackService.handlePaymentNotify, and withdraw.bspay routes as WITHDRAW to WithdrawApplyService.handleWithdrawNotify, which maps trans_status S to status 4, F to 5 (with failure reason), P to 3, skips already-SUCCESS replays, and keys the apply row by req_seq_id.

AdapayCallbackOrchestratorService routes callback types via AdapayCallbackEventTypeRegistry (payment.succeeded/failed, corp_member.succeeded/failed, corp_member_update.succeeded/failed, payment_reverse.succeeded/failed) and acks payment.close.* without processing; the PAYMENT handler routes description=depositRecharge to the deposit recharge callback and everything else to AdapayOrdersTradePaymentCallbackService.applyPaymentSucceeded, which stamps adapay_div_status=DIVED when description=membercard.

The adapay and bspay orders-side callback services implement the same NOTPAY-guard idempotency and Redis daily trade_no sequencing (h_trade_no_/c_trade_no_ keys, 86400s TTL, MdMd-seq shape) as the shared OrdersTradePaymentCallbackService, but their SUCCESS branch ends in a deliberately empty noopFinishEventsForThisIteration() — the trade-finish fan-out is not published from these two callback paths.

The admin payment-setting API is PaymentController at /api/v1/trade/payment (POST/GET /setting with route aliases trade.payment.setting.set/get, GET /open-status, /list, /hfpayversionstatus, /rsakey); PaymentSettingSaveService fans out to per-channel writers for wxpay, alipay, paypal, hfpay, adapay, offline_pay, chinaumspay, bspay, icbcpay and doumen_intl, while pay_type=point_pay is diverted to PointMemberRuleSaveService.savePointPayFirstOnly.

Channel credentials live in Redis (companys Redis unless noted), keyed by PaymentSettingRedisKeys: (distributorId?) + wxPaymentSetting:/alipayPaymentSetting:/paypalPaymentSetting: + sha1(companyId); platform-level doumenIntlPaymentSetting:, hfPaymentSetting:, bspaySetting:, icbcPaymentSetting:, paymentTypeOpenConfig:, chinaumsPaymentSetting:{sha1}_{subKey}, offline_paySetting:{sha1}:{lang}; adaPaySetting: sits on the shared Redis; plus appId-to-companyId reverse maps and doumen token keys (doumen_intl:token:{accessCode} with logical expiry, doumen_intl:token_refresh:last_scheduled_run watermark).

Doumen-intl is mutually exclusive with every other channel: DoumenIntlMutualExclusionService.validateBeforeSave throws 请先关闭斗门国际收银台 when opening any other channel while doumen is open (point_pay exempt), and enabling doumen rewrites is_open=false across all nine other setting keys in the same save; separately, /hfpayversionstatus exposes the instance-level flag ecshopx.payment.hfpay-is-open (default false, accepts 1/true/yes/on) via HfpayVersionStatusService.

Doumen-intl gateway access is config-gated by ecshopx.payment.doumen-intl.* (base-url, notify-url, tokenRefreshIntervalMinutes default 115); DoumenIntlTokenRefreshScheduler is a Spring @Scheduled every-minute job (not XXL-Job) that checks a Redis watermark and refreshes tokens for every company holding a doumen setting; the gateway client offers checkout create, payment query and refund against /api/acquire/* paths, and DoumenIntlStatusMapper normalizes SUCCEED/FAILED into SUCCESS/FAIL/NOTPAY.

Refunds route through OrdersRefundPaymentDispatchService.dispatch: point (points return), deposit (deposit refund), pos/offline_pay/prepaid_point (immediate SUCCESS, no gateway) are special-cased first; the remaining pay types are matched against ordered AftersalesRefundPayChannelExecutor beans (Spring @Order), returning the first supports(payType) match or throwing 未知的支付方式.

The refund executor chain is ordered by @Order: Hfpay 45 (ACOU reb001, expects resp_code C00002, publishes the refund-success event), StandardOnlinePay 50 (wxpay*/alipay*/bspay via three runners), Chinaums 52 (UMS open-platform refund with OPEN-BODY-SIG authorization, appending a random 2-digit suffix to refundOrderId on resubmit), Adapay 55 (Refund.create on a succeeded AdapayPaymemtConfirm row with randomized refund_order_no, falling back to the reverse service without one), DoumenIntl 55 (doumen gateway refund by order_id).

The three runners behind the standard executor are channel-specific: WxpaySecapiAftersalesRefundRunner calls the v2 certificate-based https://api.mch.weixin.qq.com/secapi/pay/refund with two-way TLS from the merchant cert/cert_key PEM (servicer variant via sub_appid/sub_mch_id); AlipayTradeAftersalesRefundRunner calls alipay.trade.refund and maps a 10000 response with fund_change=N to PROCESSING rather than SUCCESS; BsPayAftersalesOnlineRefundRunner issues V3TradePaymentScanpayRefundRequest with a deliberately randomized req_seq_id (refundBn + random + timestamp) so retried refunds never collide at the gateway's idempotency key.

When every item of an order finishes aftersales, AftersalesService.scheduleAutoCloseOrderItemAftersales closes due item lines and triggers gateway payment confirmation per channel: adapay per item via AdapayScheduleAutoPaymentConfirmationPort (impl returns early unless all items are CLOSED, then inserts a pending AdapayPaymemtConfirm row and calls the gateway), bspay collected into a per-order dedupe map; the schedule-port interfaces live in ecshopx-common/port/payment so no module cycle forms.

Pending payment confirmations are retried by XXL-Job: adapay-confirm-retry and bspay-confirm-retry handlers (in payment/cron) scan pending confirm rows older than 600 seconds; payment's AdaPaymentService/BsPayService are one-line delegates onto AdaPayPaymentConfirmRetryPort/BspayPaymentConfirmRetryPort interfaces in ecshopx-common/port/payment, implemented by adapters in the channel bundles — the common-port pattern that avoids a payment-to-channel Maven cycle.

WeChat merchant-payment withdrawals are polled to a terminal state by the wechat-query-merchant-payment XXL-Job: WechatPayService.scheduleQueryMerchantPayment takes up to 100 WECHAT+PROCESS MerchantPaymentTrade rows, queries GET /v3/transfer/batches/batch-id/{batchId} via WechatBatchTransferQueryHttp (WechatPayV3AuthHeader authorization), maps FINISHED with success_num>0 to SUCCESS, FINISHED otherwise and CLOSED to FAIL, writes the trade status, then fans the scene result back to the community-chief / distribution-rebate / popularize-rebate scene tables.

MerchantPaymentTrade (orders_merchant_trade) is the withdrawal ticket shared by rails: payment_action selects WECHAT or HFPAY, rel_scene_name the business scene (rebate_cash_withdrawal, community_chief_cash_withdrawal, popularize_rebate_cash_withdrawal); MerchantPaymentTradeQueryService implements the common cron/read ports — listWechatProcess pages payment_action=WECHAT status=PROCESS rows — plus per-scene count/list readers.

The hfpay distributor auto-T1 withdrawal flow is persist-then-dispatch: the hypay-distributor-withdraw XXL-Job scans approved enter-applies (status=3, apply types 1/2/3), skips manual-mode companies (HfpayWithdrawSet.withdraw_method=2), checks qry001 balance minus the retain amount, inserts an HfpayCashRecord (T1, status 0) and only then publishes event:268 HfpayDistributorWithdrawEvent; the sync listener re-loads the row by id and submits cash01 (mer_priv=cash01_distributor), setting cash_status=1 on C00001 (accepted) and 3 otherwise.

The hypay-check-cash XXL-Job (HfpayCashRecordService.scheduleCheckStatus) drives processing withdrawals to terminal state: it pages cash_status=1 rows older than 2 days, guards each row with a Redis SETNX lock hfpay:{id} (10s expiry with stale-lock deletion), calls qry008, maps trans_stat=S to status 2 plus an event:296 distributor-withdraw-success publish, error resp_codes to status 3, and leaves C00001/C00002 (still processing) alone; per its javadoc it is not per-row try/catch — one bad row aborts the run.

The popularize rebate withdrawal on the hfpay rail is orchestrated by bootstrap's HfpayPopularizeCashWithdrawalMerchantPaymentService (implementing popularize's port): it validates the real-name enter-apply and cash bank card, idempotently ensures an HfpayMerchantPayment row, moves funds within Huifu via pay026 (div_type=0), inserts the MerchantPaymentTrade (payment_action HFPAY, hf_cash_type T1, status NOT_PAY) and publishes event:270; the orders-side listener then submits cash01 (mer_priv=cash01_popularize) and sets PAYING on C00001, FAIL otherwise.

HfpayTradeRecordService maintains the hfpay ledger from dispatch events: paySuccess on trade-finish (event:291 and the event:292 offline-approval twin, via the trade-record listener), profit on event:295, refundSuccess on event:294, withdraw on event:296; profit splitting is driven by event:267 with HfpayProfitSplitConfirmService.pay006 performing the delayed split confirmation — all event/listener constants live in ecshopx-common/dispatch/HfpayDispatchEventNames and are registered by bootstrap Hfpay*RegistrationConfig classes in the @Order(76)-(99) band.

Every HfPay ACOU gateway call (corp01, solo01, bind01, user01, unbd01, qry001, qry008, cash01, pay026, pay012, pay006, reb001) goes through HfPayAcouJsonPostClient.postSigned: the JSON payload is signed as an attached CFCA PKCS7 base64 signature with the merchant pfx at chinapnrPayment/{merCustId}/cfca.pfx (synced from local storage by HfPayPaymentSettingService), and mer_cust_id/version/check_value are posted as a form — hfpay is the only channel whose signing material is a local-storage certificate file rather than a Redis-stored key.

Chinaums division settlement is file-based over SFTP (ecshopx.ums.sftp.*): downloads pull final_{base}.ret result files; verification fetches the matching .chk and validates RSA-SHA256 over the .ret file's MD5 hex using the rsa_public_path certificate; uploads send the data file plus a .chk signed with the merchant pfx (rsa_private_path + password) under the same scheme; local artifacts land under ecshopx.storage.local.root, and the SFTP services are @Profile(!test-cron) with test doubles under test-cron.

Payment-stack XXL-Job handlers all share one envelope (run service, log cost, on exception publish CronAlertEvent(handlerName, e) and rethrow): payment owns wechat-query-merchant-payment, adapay-confirm-retry, bspay-confirm-retry; hfpay owns hypay-distributor-withdraw, hypay-check-cash, hfpay-company-daily-statistics, hfpay-distributor-daily-statistics; adapay owns adapy-draw-cash-queue (the adapy misspelling is in source and must be matched by job config) and adapay-get-submit-license-audit.

The adapay open-account flow is stubbed in this iteration: OpenAccountService.scheduleGetSubmitLicenseStatus throws 暂不支持开户流程 for any audit_status=I row (driven by the adapay-get-submit-license-audit cron), with the same throw in AdapayLicenseSubmitService, AdapayMerchantEntryCreateService, AdapayMerchantResidentCreateService, and AdapayUploadLicenseFacadeService.
The paypal success endpoint GET /api/v1/paypal/success is a redirect stub that returns an empty 200 with no verification — it is not a notify processing path.

AlipayNotifyFacade (POST /api/v1/alipay/notify) resolves the owning company BEFORE signature verification: it picks deposit-vs-order from the attach=depositRecharge marker, then asks the owning side to prove the company via AlipayNotifyDepositSidePort.requireCompanyIdByDepositTradeId (deposit Trade row) or AlipayNotifyOrderSidePort.requireCompanyIdByTradeId (orders Trade row), and throws 储值单企业与回调企业不一致 / 订单企业与回调企业不一致 when the row's company differs from the notify context company.

AlipayNotifyFacade normalizes TRADE_SUCCESS/TRADE_FINISHED to SUCCESS, routes depositRecharge to AlipayNotifyDepositSidePort.rechargeCallback and everything else to AlipayNotifyOrderSidePort.applyTradePaymentAfterAlipay, and answers any exception inside the apply with an empty HTTP 200 (ResponseEntity.ok().build()) so a business replay never triggers a gateway retry.

AlipayH5SyncReturnService.alipayResult (GET /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/trade/payment/alipay/result, front @FrontNoAuth) is a signed sync return, not a server notify: after verifySignedNotify it queries the gateway via AlipayOpenapiTradeQueryService.queryTrade and routes on the queried trade_status (not the return params), decoding passback_params for attach/company_id and cross-checking a passback company_id against the deposit row in the deposit branch.

PaymentSettingDistributorAccessGuard gates admin payment-setting read/write before any per-channel writer runs: a distributor operator is forced to their JWT distributor_id (a mismatched or missing id yields 无权限 / ForbiddenException), an HQ operator keeps the request distributor id, and any non-zero target distributor must belong to the company via DistributorGetInfoSimpleByDistributorIdPort; only then does DoumenIntlMutualExclusionService.validateBeforeSave and the channel writer run.

BSPay withdrawal execution is dispatched over the dispatch bus: the interface WithdrawJobDispatchPublisher lives in ecshopx-common/dispatch, is implemented in bootstrap by WithdrawJobDispatchPublisherImpl (dispatching BsPayBundleDispatchJobNames.WITHDRAW_JOB = "job:93:BsPayBundle\Jobs\WithdrawJob" ASYNC on the REDIS driver, default queue, platform-default retry), and bootstrap's WithdrawJobRegistrationConfig registers WithdrawJobHandler (ecshopx-bspay) for that job; the handler requires numeric apply_id/company_id in the payload and calls WithdrawApplyService.executeHuifuWithdraw. WithdrawController enqueues the job only after an approve audit.

WithdrawApplyService enforces tenant and role scoping on the withdraw lifecycle: auditWithdraw is admin-only (只有管理员可以审核提现申请), refuses re-audit of a non-status-0 row, and every operation loads the row via requireWithdrawApplyForCompany which throws ForbiddenException (无权操作该提现申请) when the row's company_id differs from the caller's — covered by WithdrawApplyServiceAuditScopeTest.

BSPay withdraw execution is replay-safe and failure-persistent: executeHuifuWithdraw skips rows already in status 3/4, resolves token_no (admin_token_no from the bspay setting or the bound UserCard.apply_no), and WithdrawHuifuWithdrawTransactionalService atomically CASes status 1/5 → 3 before calling the gateway, persisting hf_seq_id/req_seq_id and keeping status 3 on trans_stat=P (otherwise 4); any exception is recorded as status 5 with the failure reason in a separate REQUIRES_NEW transaction so it survives the outer rollback, then rethrown for the dispatch retry policy.

AdapayTradeListQueryService and AdapayTradeExportDataService honor a distributor_name request filter (resolved to distributor ids within the company) only after AdapayTradeDistributorNameScopeGuard.assertAllowed(jwtMap), which rejects any JWT with operator_type=distributor via ForbiddenException (无权筛选其他店铺) so a shop operator cannot widen the trade list/export beyond their JWT distributor_id; ECX-10906/10908 PHP parity, probed by AdapayTradeDistributorNameScopeGuardTest, AdapayTradeListQueryServiceDistributorNameScopeTest, and AdapayTradeExportDataServiceDistributorNameScopeTest.

AdapayWithdrawSetSaveService.save enforces distributor scope on the per-distributor auto-withdraw rule via AdapayWithdrawSetDistributorScopeGuard.assertTargetAllowed: admin passes unconditionally, other operators must have the target distributor id inside their JWT shop scope (distributor_id plus the distributor_ids claim), and an empty JWT shop scope (HQ-style operator) gets company-wide latitude subject to a separate company-membership check (DistributorRepositoryGetInfoSimpleService.getDistributorInfoForCompanyShop), with 店铺权限不足 on any miss — probed by AdapayWithdrawSetSaveServiceScopeTest.

The deposit recharge callback (AdapayDepositTradeRechargeCallbackService.rechargeCallback) is idempotent by atomic claim (ECX-10915): a row already at trade_status SUCCESS throws 更新已处理，不需要更新, and the flip itself is a guarded update with a trade_status != SUCCESS WHERE condition — a 0-row result throws the same already-processed exception — so concurrent double-notifies cannot double-credit the Redis deposit counters (shopDepositTotal, dayRechargeTotal{date}, per-user balance); the recharge SMS notice is published after commit via RechargeSendSmsNoticeJobDispatchPublisher. Probed by AdapayDepositTradeRechargeCallbackServiceIdempotencyTest and AdapayDepositTradeRechargeCallbackServiceSmsDispatchTest.
